cases.name: Brittany Moran
cases.about: “She was good-hearted, she loved kids, she loved people... loves people,” Audrey Moran said of her daughter, Brittany. “She always had a smile, she always told us how much she loved us.
cases.narrative: On 5/30/2024, her body was found at the 4500 block of Paddock Rd, in Cincinnati, OH.
